title: Sleep Routines
learningGoal: Help parents create predictable, calming sleep routines that support regulation, healthy development, and smoother bedtimes.
microLesson: Sleep is essential for a child’s emotional regulation, behaviour, learning, and physical health. Children settle more easily when bedtime is predictable and calm. A consistent routine signals to the brain that it is time to wind down, helping the body shift from alertness to rest. Good sleep routines include reducing stimulation before bed, using a consistent sequence of steps, and creating a safe, quiet sleep environment. When parents stay calm and predictable, children feel secure and bedtime becomes smoother over time.
activity: Choose one part of your bedtime routine to strengthen (e.g., reducing screens before bed, adding a calming step, keeping the same bedtime). Implement it for one night and write a reflection on how your child responded.
